allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A young couple is pushed to the limits of sanity as they attempt to be reunited amid the chaos of a pandemic outbreak. The streets erupt into violence and depravity, as those infected are driven to enact the most cruel and ghastly things imaginable.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As an outbreak unleashes pure cruelty across the city, can two people hold onto their sanity long enough to find one another alive?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Amid a sudden viral pandemic, the streets descend into sadistic violence and madness. Rob Jabbaz directs as a separated young couple attempts to reunite while infected citizens carry out unspeakable depravities.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Unrelenting, brutally heavy horror fueled by rapid escalation, intense suspense, and an overwhelming sense of collapse.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Rob Jabbaz takes a familiar infection premise and drives it into punishing, fast-paced territory, turning a couple's desperate reunion into a tense survival gauntlet.
